rows.what the ink shows: After the separate baseline B and A, the deleted sign has a sloping left member and apparently enclosed upper and lower spaces, but the heavy diagonal/right sweep makes their original closure indeterminate between B and E. Short upper-right prongs merge into that deletion ink rather than forming an independently separable raised star; the closing parenthesis itself is clear farther right.

After the separate B and A there is one overwritten baseline sign with a left stem, central arm and two apparent counters whose right boundary coincides with a heavy curved cancellation, leaving B versus E unresolved. A small loop to its upper right is crossed and continued into the closing-parenthesis area; the page's clean looped star is compatible with it, but does not establish a separate superscript here.

The sign immediately before the opening parenthesis has a closed oblique upper loop and a small enclosed lower box, with a lower stroke turning right like an E foot. The nearby clean E forms have open right-hand arms, whereas this overtraced sign has B-like closures; the overlapping strokes do not select a single E or B reading.
